summary: Add tested iOS delivery and request-draft models, and preserve an ambiguous answer's original identity when a later replay is refused.

replay.detail: No graph replay or data migration is required.

schema.detail: No server or wire schema changes. Internal answer outcomes distinguish refused and unconfirmed delivery and retain an explicit same-request check.

rules.detail: Only a guaranteed non-application permits another action identity. An authoritative closed item settles review without proving delivery of the earlier answer.

compatibility.detail: Existing boolean-result callers retain their current interface. The new models do not expose new screens or controls in this change.

manual.detail: No new user interaction is introduced by the model-only change.

recovery.detail: An ambiguous answer is not rebuilt with a fresh identity after a later stale-fence response. The retained check remains in memory only; this is not a durable outbox after process termination.
